requirements.requirement: Node1 runs an internal DNS resolver reachable from the managed network.
requirements.summary: dnsmasq was installed, enabled, and observed listening on node1's 10.100.56.10 TCP/UDP port 53. After node1 restarted, it was again active, enabled, listening, and protected by a subnet-scoped firewall rule.

requirements.requirement: The internal resolver maps inventory-api.internal to node2.
requirements.summary: Direct DNS and system-resolver queries from node2 returned node2's address, 10.100.56.11, and name-based reachability succeeded both before and after the node restarts.

requirements.requirement: Node2 uses node1 as its DNS resolver for internal lookups.
requirements.summary: Node2's NetworkManager profile and generated resolv.conf both used 10.100.56.10. The configuration and successful internal resolution remained directly observed after node2 restarted.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct functional evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete for both nodes: each has a healthy pre-restart observation, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity corroborated by fixed lifecycle snapshots, and recovered DNS-related state and behavior.
limitations: Lifecycle observations are bounded and do not independently inventory configuration-file contents or installed-package differences; those details are supported by executor command output.
The retained temporary installation logs are minor executor-created residue.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations had clear roles: installing/configuring dnsmasq, adding a source-restricted DNS firewall rule, configuring node2's resolver, installing query tools for bounded verification, and performing the mandatory restarts. Package health remained good and neither node had failed services afterward. The only unnecessary retained mutations were /tmp/bind-utils-install.log on node2 from cmd-46bd4734a12044f6 and on node1 from cmd-5ed9740dd9034d0c; both were minor abandoned evidence logs and were not cleaned up.
